candidates.change_summary: Replace the addition assignment to balances[msg.sender] with a subtraction, causing Deposit to decrease the sender's balance by msg.value instead of increasing it.
Remove the bounds check require, allowing an underflow/incorrect behavior when balances are adjusted (in Solidity >=0.8 this will revert on underflow), changing observable outcomes.
Move the Log.AddMessage call before updating balances, so the log records the deposit before the balance changes (observable if reentrancy or external observer reads between events).
Insert a conditional that skips updating balances when msg.value is zero, so zero-value deposits no longer change balances (observable for some keys).
